subtitle: Manage your personal preferences and system settings

timezone.title: Time Zone Settings
timezone.description: Configure the time zone used for displaying times. This affects your class schedule, report times, and all time-related features.
timezone.search_placeholder: Search region or city (e.g., Taipei, London, UTC...)

appearance.title: Appearance & Personalization
appearance.description: Customize how the interface looks for a more comfortable experience.
appearance.font_scale_hint: Changes will be applied immediately to all pages.

teacher_roles.title: Teacher Role Types
teacher_roles.description: Manage roles available for class assignments. Built-in roles cannot be removed.

incomplete_notifications.title: Incomplete Report Notifications
incomplete_notifications.description: Choose which assigned roles receive incomplete-report reminders on the dashboard.
incomplete_notifications.inheritance_hint: Class settings override classroom settings, and classroom settings override the global default. Selecting no roles removes this override.
